summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a private placement of 16.8 million units at $0.50 per unit, each consisting of one ordinary share and a warrant to purchase two shares at $0.70, for gross proceeds of $8.4 million. This is a routine capital raising transaction, not a special situation like a Rights Offering (no pro-rata rights, no oversubscription privilege). Conducted under Regulation S offshore, the securities are unregistered. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is applicable. The filing simply fulfills a periodic disclosure obligation for a foreign private issuer. There is no event-driven angle to watch beyond the closing itself.
